niche_preference_profile: This user prefers clean, airy, well-structured interfaces that feel complete and easy to scan. They like strong visual hierarchy, clear labels, visible actions, and enough content density to feel useful, but not so much that the screen feels cluttered. They generally favor light, bright, modern presentations with polished card/grouping systems, though they sometimes accept dark modal/alert treatments when the content is focused and the background is simplified.

criteria.description: Strong title hierarchy, distinct section separation, and obvious primary actions that are easy to scan.
A layout that is spacious and breathable, yet still shows enough content and options to feel complete and efficient.
Well-separated cards or grouped sections with balanced composition and a polished, app-like finish.
Screens that feel filled out and functional, with visible items, details, and fewer blank or unfinished areas.
Prominent, immediately usable controls such as toggles, buttons, and row actions that clearly invite interaction.
A light, bright, airy visual style with white or pale surfaces and softer contrast rather than heavy dark canvases.
Concise, descriptive labels and copy that explain what each setting or action does without ambiguity.
Interfaces that stay focused on the core task, avoid unnecessary clutter, and reduce extra explanatory or decorative elements.
Layouts that are easy to skim quickly, with clear row structure, visible item details, and recognizable affordances.
Centered, isolated modal or alert states with minimal background distraction and calm, controlled emphasis on the message and CTA.
